form.label: CIM Coverage Command Center
form.description: SIEM validation view: every sourcetype a tenant sends, whether it is contracted and cataloged, and how well it is CIM-normalized. Open the "How to read this" tab for what the flags and percentages mean.

search.query: | inputlookup dc_datasets_lookup | stats first(ae_name) as ae_name by uhgid | eval index_pattern=if(uhgid="core","sec_*_core","sec_*_".uhgid), label=ae_name." (".uhgid.")" | sort ae_name

| tstats count as events_7d, max(_time) as last_seen where `dc_scope_indexes` index=$index_filter$ sourcetype=$sourcetype_filter$ earliest=-7d by index sourcetype | eval discovered=1 | append [ | inputlookup dc_contract_master | eval index=lower(index) | search index=$index_filter$ sourcetype=$sourcetype_filter$ | fields index sourcetype ] | stats sum(events_7d) as events_7d, max(last_seen) as last_seen, max(discovered) as discovered by index sourcetype | fillnull value=0 discovered events_7d | `dc_key` | `dc_valid_sourcetype(sourcetype)` | lookup dc_sourcetype_rejections_lookup sourcetype OUTPUT status as reject_status | lookup dc_datasets_lookup dataset_id OUTPUT status as catalog_status, cim_datamodel as catalog_cim | lookup dc_datasets_lookup uhgid OUTPUT ae_name | eval ae_name=mvindex(ae_name,0) | lookup dc_contract_master sourcetype index OUTPUT contract_issue as contract_ticket, cde_approval, datamodels as contract_cim | lookup dc_contract_master sourcetype OUTPUT contract_issue as other_ticket | join type=left index sourcetype [ | inputlookup dc_cim_coverage_scorecard_lookup | stats max(coverage_score) as cim_score, values(domain) as cim_models_scored by index sourcetype ] | eval sourcetype_check=case(sourcetype_valid="no","MALFORMED", reject_status="rejected","REJECTED", 1=1,"ok") | eval in_catalog=if(isnotnull(catalog_status),"yes","no") | eval contract=case(isnotnull(contract_ticket),"CONTRACTED", isnotnull(other_ticket),"OTHER TENANT ONLY", 1=1,"NO CONTRACT") | eval contract_ticket=coalesce(mvindex(contract_ticket,0), mvindex(other_ticket,0)) | eval cde_approved=case(contract="NO CONTRACT","", lower(mvindex(cde_approval,0))="true","yes", 1=1,"pending") | eval expected_cim=coalesce(if(contract_cim="",null(),mvindex(contract_cim,0)), if(catalog_cim="",null(),catalog_cim)) | eval cim_flag=case(isnull(cim_score),"NOT IN SCORED MODELS", cim_score=0,"NO CIM COVERAGE", cim_score<20,"CRITICAL LOW", cim_score<50,"VERY LOW", cim_score<80,"LOW", 1=1,"OK") | eval gap=case( sourcetype_check="MALFORMED","Fix sourcetype at the source (props.conf / HEC override)", sourcetype_check="REJECTED","Rejected - AE to stop sending", discovered=0,"Contracted but no data in 7 days - confirm onboarding", contract="NO CONTRACT","Ingested with no contract - create a contract", contract="OTHER TENANT ONLY","Contracted for another tenant only - extend the contract", in_catalog="no","Contracted but not cataloged - add to the catalog seed", cim_flag IN ("NO CIM COVERAGE","CRITICAL LOW","VERY LOW"),"CIM normalization gap", cim_flag="NOT IN SCORED MODELS" AND isnotnull(expected_cim),"Check CIM mapping - expected ".expected_cim, cde_approved="pending","Awaiting CDE approval", 1=1,"OK") | eval priority=case(gap="OK","OK", match(gap,"^(Fix|Rejected|Ingested)"),"HIGH", 1=1,"MEDIUM") | eval last_seen=if(discovered=1,strftime(last_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),"never (7d)"), cim_models_scored=mvjoin(cim_models_scored,", ") | fields uhgid index sourcetype ae_name priority events_7d last_seen discovered sourcetype_check in_catalog contract contract_ticket cde_approved expected_cim cim_models_scored cim_score cim_flag gap
| where discovered=1 AND contract="NO CONTRACT" AND sourcetype_check="ok" | stats count
| where cim_flag IN ("NO CIM COVERAGE","CRITICAL LOW","VERY LOW") | stats count

panel.title: Every sourcetype discovered or contracted - worst gaps first

search.query: | eval gap_rank=case(sourcetype_check!="ok",1, contract="NO CONTRACT",2, contract="OTHER TENANT ONLY",3, discovered=0,4, in_catalog="no",5, gap="CIM normalization gap",6, gap="OK",9, 1=1,7) | sort gap_rank - events_7d | table priority ae_name index sourcetype events_7d last_seen sourcetype_check in_catalog contract contract_ticket cde_approved expected_cim cim_models_scored cim_score cim_flag gap

format.colorPalette: {"NO CIM COVERAGE":#DC4E41,"CRITICAL LOW":#DC4E41,"VERY LOW":#F1813F,"LOW":#F8BE34,"OK":#53A051,"NOT IN SCORED MODELS":#708794}

search.query: | where gap!="OK" | eval tenant=coalesce(ae_name,uhgid) | eval gap_type=case(match(gap,"^Fix|^Rejected"),"Sourcetype problem", match(gap,"^Ingested"),"No contract", match(gap,"^Contracted for another"),"Contract for another tenant", match(gap,"^Contracted but no data"),"Contracted, no data", match(gap,"^Contracted but not cataloged"),"Not cataloged", match(gap,"CIM"),"CIM gap", 1=1,"Awaiting CDE") | chart count over tenant by gap_type

panel.title: CIM field coverage scorecard (as of the last DC-101 run, every 4 hours)

search.query: | inputlookup dc_cim_coverage_scorecard_lookup | search index=$index_filter$ sourcetype=$sourcetype_filter$ | eval investigation_flag=case( has_any_coverage=0,"NO CIM COVERAGE", coverage_score<20,"CRITICAL LOW", coverage_score<50,"VERY LOW", coverage_score<80,"LOW", true(),"OK") | eval checked=strftime(checked,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | table domain index sourcetype total coverage_score investigation_flag checked | sort domain coverage_score

| tstats summariesonly=true count as total from datamodel=Authentication where index=$index_filter$ sourcetype=$sourcetype_filter$ by index sourcetype | append [ | tstats summariesonly=true count as has_user from datamodel=Authentication where index=$index_filter$ sourcetype=$sourcetype_filter$ Authentication.user!="unknown" by index sourcetype ] | append [ | tstats summariesonly=true count as has_action from datamodel=Authentication where index=$index_filter$ sourcetype=$sourcetype_filter$ Authentication.action!="unknown" by index sourcetype ] | append [ | tstats summariesonly=true count as has_src from datamodel=Authentication where index=$index_filter$ sourcetype=$sourcetype_filter$ Authentication.src!="unknown" by index sourcetype ] | append [ | tstats summariesonly=true count as has_dest from datamodel=Authentication where index=$index_filter$ sourcetype=$sourcetype_filter$ Authentication.dest!="unknown" by index sourcetype ] | append [ | tstats summariesonly=true count as has_app from datamodel=Authentication where index=$index_filter$ sourcetype=$sourcetype_filter$ Authentication.app!="unknown" by index sourcetype ] | stats sum(total) as total, sum(has_user) as has_user, sum(has_action) as has_action, sum(has_src) as has_src, sum(has_dest) as has_dest, sum(has_app) as has_app by index sourcetype | eval pct_user=round(100*has_user/total,2), pct_action=round(100*has_action/total,2), pct_src=round(100*has_src/total,2), pct_dest=round(100*has_dest/total,2), pct_app=round(100*has_app/total,2) | eval coverage_score=round((pct_user*0.30)+(pct_action*0.25)+(pct_src*0.20)+(pct_dest*0.15)+(pct_app*0.10),2) | eval investigation_flag=case(coverage_score<20,"CRITICAL LOW",coverage_score<50,"VERY LOW",coverage_score<80,"LOW",true(),"OK") | table index sourcetype total pct_user pct_action pct_src pct_dest pct_app coverage_score investigation_flag | sort coverage_score

html.p: Lists every sourcetype the tenant sent in the last 7 days, plus every sourcetype in the contract master for that tenant, so gaps show in both directions. Each row is checked against the contract master (GitHub sync, DC-37), the catalog, sourcetype rejections, and the CIM scorecard (DC-101).

tr.td: MALFORMED: the name contains raw event text or a config comment, not a real sourcetype; fix it at the source. REJECTED: reviewed and rejected; the AE should stop sending it. ok: valid name.
CONTRACTED: a contract exists for this sourcetype in this tenant's index. OTHER TENANT ONLY: contracted elsewhere, not for this tenant. NO CONTRACT: data is being ingested with no contract.
Whether CDE has approved the contract (pending until the contract master says true).
The data models the contract or the catalog says this sourcetype should feed.

The best CIM field coverage score for this sourcetype (see below). NOT IN SCORED MODELS means none of its events reached the 8 data models DC-101 scores, either because it is not mapped to CIM or because it belongs to a model not scored yet (Email, Network_Resolution).
HIGH: malformed or rejected sourcetype, or data ingested with no contract. MEDIUM: any other gap. OK: no gap.
The single most important action for the row, in priority order: sourcetype problem, no data, no contract, contract for another tenant only, not cataloged, CIM gap, awaiting CDE.

html.p: For each sourcetype in each data model, the score is the weighted percentage of its events where the model's key fields are populated (not "unknown"). 100 means every event has every key field. It measures whether fields are filled in, not whether the values are correct.
Example (Authentication): 1,000 events; user on 90%, action on 100%, src on 50%, dest on 100%, app on 0%. Score = 0.30x90 + 0.25x100 + 0.20x50 + 0.15x100 + 0.10x0 = 77, LOW.
